name: Refresh Mental Health
one_liner: Large US chain of outpatient mental health practices, owned by Optum since 2022, offering in-person care through local clinics.
best_for: People looking for an outpatient therapist or psychiatric prescriber through a local practice
People with insurance who want in-person care near home
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want a single nationwide online therapy app
People who need eating disorder treatment (Refresh closed that division in 2024)
short_description: Outpatient mental health practice group based in Jacksonville Beach, Florida, with hundreds of clinics in many states; owned by Optum (UnitedHealth Group).
long_description: Refresh Mental Health is an outpatient mental health company headquartered in Jacksonville Beach, Florida, founded in 2017. By early 2022 it had grown to over 300 locations in 37 states, and Optum, part of UnitedHealth Group, acquired it that year. In 2024 it bought CARE Counseling in Minnesota (therapy and medication management) and closed its eating disorder treatment division. Care is delivered through local practices, so services, telehealth options, insurance and prices vary by clinic. We could not open the company's own website or privacy policy for this review, so those details are unconfirmed.
